title: Red-Teaming a Sovereign LLM, Its Reasoning and Its Training Stages
abstract: arXiv:2611.32710v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Open-weight large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for applications with sensitive information. We investigate whether confidentiality instructions in system prompt can protect such information. We red-team Apertus v1.5, an open sovereign LLM, and five other model families across six languages and reasoning modes. We use synthetic personal records to evaluate direct disclosure, correction baits, yes/no verification, derived-value queries, reasoning leakage and authorisation checks. We also explore copyright attribution, historical misrepresentation and stereotyping. Despite confidentiality instructions, Apertus 8B and 70B leak information in 96% and 95% of requests, respectively, in correction-bait attacks. Verification and derived-value queries also expose protected information without necessarily revealing identifiers. translated_title: 对一个主权大语言模型、其推理过程及其训练阶段的红队测试
translated_abstract: 开源权重大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被部署用于涉及敏感信息的应用中。我们研究了系统提示词中的保密指令是否能够保护此类信息。我们对开源主权LLM Apertus v1.5以及另外五个模型家族进行了红队测试，涵盖六种语言和多种推理模式。我们使用合成的个人记录来评估直接泄露、纠正诱饵攻击、是非验证、派生值查询、推理泄露和授权检查等攻击方式。我们还探讨了版权归属、历史歪曲和刻板印象等问题。尽管设有保密指令，Apertus 8B和70B在纠正诱饵攻击中分别有96%和95%的请求泄露了信息。验证和派生值查询也会在不直接暴露标识符的情况下暴露受保护的信息。此外，即使最终答案未透露机密记录，推理轨迹仍可能泄露这些机密信息。
tldr: 该研究通过多语言红队测试发现，即使系统提示词中包含保密指令，主权开源LLM Apertus在诱饵攻击下仍会以超过95%的比例泄露敏感信息，且其推理轨迹也可能泄露最终答案中刻意隐去的机密内容。
en_tdlr: Red-teaming the sovereign open-weight LLM Apertus across six languages reveals that system-prompt confidentiality instructions fail to protect sensitive data—models leak information in over 95% of bait attacks, and reasoning traces can expose confidential records even when final answers withhold them.
